text: It is confirmed that N. nigricollis venom contains several phospholipases, one of which is a basic phospholipase A. This enzyme is toxic for mice when injected intravenously. In vitro studies have shown that it reacts with egg yolk lecithin, producing lysolecithin, and inhibits blood clotting. An immunological identity has been established between this basic phospholipase and two acidic phospholipases found in the same venom.
